labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected Live/redirect behaviour that may be a lock-ordering deadlock

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example; asks for a minimal reproduction, Rich version and rich.diagnose output

body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. To investigate the lock ordering, we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces the freeze: a short script that starts `Live` with redirection and `auto_refresh=True`, with a second thread or task printing or logging during refresh. Please also include your Rich version and the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`.

Redirection is documented in docs/source/live.rst (https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst), which also describes `redirect_stdout=False` and `redirect_stderr=False`.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
